models.title: Carhart factor contribution to active return
models.summary: Active-return contribution of one factor as active sensitivity times factor return.

relationship.original_equation: Contribution = (sensitivity difference) x (factor return), from R_p - R_f = a_p + b_p1 RMRF + b_p2 SMB + b_p3 HML + b_p4 WML + E_p (Eq11)
relationship.locator: PDF: LM1 Carhart model Eq 11 with Exhibit 5, printed pp. 17-18 (PDF pp. 25-26): HML 0.40x5.10% = 2.04%, RMRF -0.05x5.52% = -0.28%, tilts total 2.12%, active 2.07%
relationship.translation_notes: d is the portfolio-minus-benchmark sensitivity to the factor; F is the factor return. Decimals. Summing contributions over factors gives the factor-tilt return (2.12% in Exhibit 5, 6.96% for Fund 1).

variables.definition: Portfolio-minus-benchmark sensitivity to the factor, decimal
Return of the factor over the period, decimal
Contribution of the factor to active return, decimal

assumptions: Sensitivities from one consistent factor regression; benchmark must fit the mandate for attribution meaning.
limitations: Single-factor slice only; total active return adds security selection (alpha-like remainder) per Exhibit 5 (2.12% + -0.05% = 2.07%). Momentum WML defined per PDF (past-year winners minus losers).
